units.title: Health, Safety and Environment in Tiling and Decorative

learning_outcomes.description: Demonstrate safe work practices and instructions

performance_criteria.description: Wear clean, smart and Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
Comply with health, safety and other relevant regulations and guidelines.
Report any cuts, bruises and wounds to personnel such as; • First Aiders • Supervisors/Managers • Health and Safety officers
Report any accident or near accident quickly and accurately to the personnel.

learning_outcomes.description: Recognize the role of learner in maintaining personal health and hygiene

performance_criteria.description: State own responsibilities under the health and safety Act.
State rules on hygiene that must be followed.
State the importance of using correct Personal Protective Equipment such as Head gear, Foot, Face & Eye, Hand, Body and Ear Protection.
State the importance of maintaining good personal hygiene.
Describe how to deal with cuts, bruises, and wounds and why it is important to do so.

learning_outcomes.description: Maintain a hygienic, safe and secure workplace

performance_criteria.description: Comply with health, hygiene and safety procedures during work
Perform emergency procedures during work
Comply with organizational security procedures.
Carry out disposal of waste and pollution control using organic and inorganic waste disposal methods.

learning_outcomes.description: Identify potential hazards at workplace

performance_criteria.description: Identify any hazards or potential hazards at workplace.
Describe the types of hazards in the workplace
State hazards that can be dealt with personally and those that should be reported to statutory authority.

learning_outcomes.description: Prevent hazards in workplace.

performance_criteria.description: Describe how to warn other people about hazards and why this is important.
State why accidents and near accidents should be reported and who it should be reported to.
Describe the types of accidents that may happen
State where to find first aid items
State safe lifting and handling techniques that should be followed
Describe organizational emergency procedures
State the possible causes of fire in the workplace.
Describe how to minimize the possibility of fire in the workplace.
State where to find the alarms and how to set them off.

units.title: Communication Systems in a Work Environment

learning_outcomes.description: Use a non- complex communication system in a work environment

performance_criteria.description: Use simple verbal means to pass on information.
Use nonverbal means to pass on information e.g. Body Language.
Interpret symbols and signs.

learning_outcomes.description: Identify the source of information in a work environment

performance_criteria.description: Locate the source of information in a work environment.
List the sources of information in a workplace
Identify sources of information.
List the communication equipment required in the work environment.
Follow procedure in reporting findings in in a work environment.

learning_outcomes.description: Demonstrate the use of various means of communication in a work environment

performance_criteria.description: Use various information network flow systems in a work environment.
Use information to avoid challenges in a work environment.
Use effectively the various communication equipment in a work environment.
Pass information effectively to the right personnel.
Pass information effectively using symbols, signs and codes.
Follow channel of communication channels in line with ethics of the work environment.

units.title: Team Work in a Work Environment

learning_outcomes.description: Demonstrate positive working relationships with co-workers

performance_criteria.description: State the need for developing positive working relationships with colleagues.
State the importance of relating with co-workers in a way that makes them feel valued and respected.
Assist team members as the need arose.
Identify the appropriate personnel when assistance is required in a work place. .
Pass information to colleagues about own work that might affect others.

learning_outcomes.description: Take responsibility within the team

performance_criteria.description: State own roles and responsibilities within the team.
Perform individual tasks in line with the team’s aspirations.
Participate actively in teamwork.

learning_outcomes.description: Comply with policies of own organization

performance_criteria.description: Work in line with organizational Policies
List some of the organizational Policies in teamwork
Explain the importance of complying with the organization’s policies .

units.title: Basic Tools, Equipment and Materials in Tiling and Decorative

learning_outcomes.description: Identify various tools and equipment suitable for tiling and stone decorative work

performance_criteria.description: List tools and equipment suitable for tiling and stone decorative work, such as trowel, straight edge, spirit level, foam, wooden float, mechanical tile cutter, glass cutter, measuring tape, mechanical compacting roller etc

Select tools and equipment suitable for tiling and stone decorative work, such as trowel, straight edge, spirit level, foam, wooden float, mechanical tile cutter, glass cutter, measuring tape, tile spacers, pinches, etc
Be able to identify and use the tools and equipment for tiling and stone decorative work.

learning_outcomes.description: Identify construction materials suitable for tiling and stone decorative work

performance_criteria.description: List construction materials suitable for tiling and stone decorative works in both internal and external conditions e.g. • Adhesives • Aggregates of different grades • Ceramic wall/floor tiles of different sizes and colors • Mosaic decorative tiles • Terrazzo tile (precast & in-situ) • Marble tiles • PVC floor Tiles • Clean Water

Identify materials of construction suitable for tiling and stone decorative works in both internal and external conditions e.g. • Adhesives • Aggregates of different grades • Ceramic wall/floor tiles of different sizes and colors • Mosaic decorative tiles • Terrazzo tile (precast & in-situ) • Marble tiles • PVC floor Tiles • Clean Water

Select materials suitable for tiling and stone decorative works in both internal and external conditions e.g. • Adhesives • Aggregates of different grades • Ceramic wall/floor tiles of different sizes and colors • Mosaic decorative tiles • Terrazzo tile (precast & in-situ) • Marble tiles • PVC floor Tiles • Clean Water

learning_outcomes.description: Identify the Methods of Handling and Storing Materials and Tools for tiling and stone decorative work

performance_criteria.description: Describe how to handle tiling/stonework materials and tools.
Describe how to store tiling/stonework materials and tools.
Maintain tools and equipment used by Tilers and decorative stone workers.

units.title: Surface preparation for tiling and stone decoration work

learning_outcomes.description: Prepare surfaces to receive tiles and stonework

performance_criteria.description: Select tools and equipment for surface preparation.
Cut and chisel projected surfaces before placing decorative stonework/tiles
Fill the chiseled surfaces flush to receive tiles/stonework.
Compact finished surface with tools and equipment

learning_outcomes.description: Clean surface to receive tiles/stonework

performance_criteria.description: Carefully select tools for cutting of tiles and stonework materials.
Remove debris away from site and clean site.
Dispose debris in an approved dump site.

learning_outcomes.description: Select tiles/ stone for surfaces.

performance_criteria.description: Identify the sizes and shapes of the tile and decorative stone.
Safely stockpile tiles and decorative stones in the work area.
Wet stone surfaces and soak tiles before laying in accordance with specifications.

learning_outcomes.description: Select materials and mix design for laying of tiles and decorative stone work.

performance_criteria.description: Identify and select materials for mixing of adhesives for laying of tiies and decorative stone work such as:- i) Cement only ii) Cement : Sand iii) White Cement iv) PVC Adhesives
Select different materials for mixing adhesives for tiling and stone decorative work such as:- i) Cement only ii) Cement : Sand iii) White Cement iv) PVC Adhesives
Prepare mixing platform by removing dirt with shovel or broom as appropriate.

learning_outcomes.description: Select tools for mixing materials for tiling and stone decorative work

performance_criteria.description: Select tools for mixing different adhesives for tiling and stone decorative work.
Use tools and mix different adhesives for tiling and stone decorative work
Properly Clean and store tools after each days’ work

learning_outcomes.description: Mix adhesives according to approved specification

performance_criteria.description: Use various batching methods for mixing materials as follows: • by normal measuring device (volume) e.g. Guage Box, Head pan, Bucket, Wheelbarrow etc • by comparing weighing scales
Mix cement sand screed by manual method
Mix cement sand screed by mechanical method.
Mix Ordinary Portland cement/white cement for grouting in accordance with standard specifications.
